description: A six-panel TEM/HRTEM composite characterising the deformation behaviour of the Zr0.50 low-density steel; five of the six panels are bright-field TEM micrographs and the remaining one is a two-part HRTEM/FFT panel. (a) Bright-field TEM of an FCC grain interior (1 µm scale bar) containing tangled dark dislocation lines labelled "Dislocations"; the inset SAED pattern is indexed <110>FCC with 002 and 1-11 reflections. (b) Bright-field TEM after severe deformation (1 µm scale bar) showing parallel slip bands traced by a blue dashed line; the inset SAED is again indexed 002/1-11, <110>FCC. (c) TEM image (200 nm scale bar) with red arrows marking a "Nanotwin region"; two superimposed indexed patterns are labelled <110>FCC (yellow) and <110>Twin (red), the twin reflections marked 002. (c1) HRTEM (5 nm scale bar) resolving alternating FCC and Twin lamellae separated by red dashed twin boundaries. (d) TEM (200 nm scale bar) showing bright nanosized "ZrC particles" (green arrows) inside the FCC grain interior. (d1) An FFT pattern indexed <110>ZrC (002 and 1-11 spots, green) above an atomic-resolution HRTEM lattice image (2 nm scale bar). Together the panels argue that deformation proceeds from dislocation glide to slip-band formation and nanotwinning, with ZrC precipitates acting as dislocation obstacles.

observations.observation: Panel (a) shows dislocations as dark tangled lines in the FCC grain interior, labelled 'Dislocations', with a 1 µm scale bar.
The SAED insets in both (a) and (b) are indexed along <110>FCC with reflections labelled 002 and 1-11.
Panel (b) shows parallel slip bands marked by a blue dashed line and labelled 'Slip bands' (1 µm scale bar).

Panel (c) marks a dark banded region with red arrows labelled 'Nanotwin region' and its SAED inset contains two superimposed reciprocal lattices indexed <110>FCC (yellow) and <110>Twin (red) (200 nm scale bar).
Panel (c1) is an HRTEM image with alternating lamellae labelled FCC (yellow) and Twin (red), delimited by red dashed twin boundaries (5 nm scale bar).
Panel (d) shows nanosized bright particles pointed out by green arrows and labelled 'ZrC particles' distributed in the FCC grain interior (200 nm scale bar).
Panel (d1) contains an FFT pattern with 002 and 1-11 reflections indexed to <110>ZrC (green) above an atomic-resolution HRTEM lattice image (2 nm scale bar).
The caption states that (a) shows planar slip in the FCC grain interior after a minor deformation and (b) reveals the slip bands after a severe deformation.
The caption states that red arrows in (c) indicate a high density of nanotwins and that (c1) is an HRTEM image of a nanoscale nanotwin.
The caption states that the FFT pattern and HRTEM image in (d1) confirm the ZrC carbide.
The citing text states that the severely deformed FCC matrix (Fig. 6b) exhibits a high density of slip bands along {111} planes, giving a strengthening effect.
The citing text states that nanotwins with ~20 nm size are generated during heavy deformation, as evidenced by Fig. 6c.
The citing text states that Fig. 6c shows twin boundaries decorated by multiple stacking faults, indicating nanotwin formation from the transition of multiple Shockley partial dislocations to twins.

The citing text states that Fig. 6d shows numerous particles of ~30 nm size distributed in the FCC grain interior that inhibit dislocation movement (precipitation strengthening), later confirmed as ZrC by HRTEM and FFT.
The citing text states that, based on Figs. 6 and 7, the average size and fraction of ZrC carbides are 30 nm and 0.006, giving a calculated precipitation strengthening of 108 MPa.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph of an FCC grain interior after minor deformation, showing a dense tangled network of dislocations labelled 'Dislocations' (blue text); 1 µm scale bar. Inset SAED pattern (bottom left) along <110>FCC with a yellow unit-cell parallelogram and reflections labelled 1-11 and 002.

Bright-field TEM micrograph after severe deformation showing a set of parallel slip bands outlined by a blue dashed line and labelled 'Slip bands'; 1 µm scale bar. Inset SAED pattern along <110>FCC with reflections labelled 002 and 1-11 (yellow parallelogram).

TEM micrograph with red arrows pointing to a dark, banded 'Nanotwin region' running diagonally; 200 nm scale bar. Overlaid axial labels <110>FCC (yellow) and <110>Twin (red). Inset SAED shows two superimposed reciprocal lattices (red and yellow parallelograms) with 002 twin reflections marked.
HRTEM image resolving lamellar structure with alternating regions labelled FCC (yellow, top and bottom) and Twin (red, middle), separated by red dashed lines marking twin boundaries; 5 nm scale bar.
TEM micrograph of the FCC grain interior containing numerous bright nanosized particles marked by green arrows and labelled 'ZrC particles'; 200 nm scale bar.

Two-part panel: top is a fast Fourier transform (FFT) pattern with a green parallelogram and reflections labelled 002 and 1-11, indexed <110>ZrC; bottom is an atomic-resolution HRTEM image showing a regular dot lattice, 2 nm scale bar.

unreadable_items: Panel (c) inset SAED: only the '002' twin reflections are labelled; the remaining spots in the two superimposed patterns carry no legible indices
Panel (c) overlaid orientation labels <110>FCC and <110>Twin are small and only partially legible at the supplied resolution
Caption panel lettering is inconsistent ('(c )' and '(d )' correspond to the image panels labelled c1 and d1); no panel is truly illegible
